function_summary: Miniature brushed DC motor with a 5:1 metal gearbox and 3 mm D-shaped output shaft.
classification_reason: Suggested locomotion actuator only. Its high speed and low reduction do not imply suitability as a load-bearing leg or direct wheel drive.
assembly_notes: Requires motor driver, power, mounting and drivetrain chosen for the load; this SKU has no encoder.
evidence_note: Vendor specifies a 12 V HPCB motor, approximately 5:1 gearing, 6800 RPM no-load and no encoder.

function_summary: FEETECH FS90 analog micro servo offering limited-range position control.
classification_reason: Suggested arm joint with neck or miniature leg-joint alternatives; the servo is not a complete limb.
assembly_notes: Includes horns and hardware; supply controller, power and links. FS90 is distinct from the continuous-rotation FS90R.
evidence_note: Vendor describes limited-range closed-loop positioning and explicitly distinguishes FS90 from FS90R.

function_summary: DRV8833 dual H-bridge carrier for low-voltage brushed DC motors or a bipolar stepper.
classification_reason: Motor power electronics support other components; no physical limb or drive assembly is supplied.
assembly_notes: Add controller, motors, power and wiring; optional current sensing needs extra resistors.
evidence_note: Vendor identifies two H-bridges and describes use with two DC motors or one bipolar stepper.

function_summary: DRV8825 carrier supplying current-controlled microstepping for a bipolar stepper motor.
classification_reason: Electrical stepper control is internal support, distinct from a motor or limb.
assembly_notes: Header pins included unsoldered; add motor, controller and motor supply, and configure current limit.
evidence_note: Vendor identifies microstepping driver board and confirms included unsoldered headers.

function_summary: Compact ATmega32U4 programmable board with USB and general-purpose I/O.
classification_reason: Provides internal control processing rather than anatomical structure.
assembly_notes: Requires application program, external parts and power; USB A-to-Micro-B cable is not included.
evidence_note: Vendor identifies ATmega32U4 module with Arduino-compatible bootloader and separately required USB cable.

function_summary: ATmega32U4 Romi control board integrating motor drivers, power circuitry and inertial sensors.
classification_reason: Control electronics for a separately supplied mobile base; not itself the base or torso.
assembly_notes: Romi chassis, batteries and optional Raspberry Pi/LCD are separate; encoder kit is available separately.
evidence_note: Vendor describes board assembly with Romi chassis and optional external Raspberry Pi/encoders.

function_summary: VL53L1X optical ranging carrier with regulation and I2C level shifting.
classification_reason: Suggested head perception component; it measures the scene in front and does not include a head shell.
assembly_notes: Add controller, power, wiring and mounting; maximum range depends on target and environment.
evidence_note: Vendor identifies a laser-ranging breakout, digital I2C readings and up-to-four-metre range.

function_summary: Eight-channel infrared reflectance array for detecting nearby surface contrast and lines.
classification_reason: Primarily navigation sensing support. Optional legs mapping means a floor-facing sensor on the locomotion base, not a wheel, joint or general head camera.
assembly_notes: Needs host timing inputs, power and a close-to-surface mount; no chassis or drive parts included.
evidence_note: Vendor specifies IR LED/phototransistor pairs for line detection with optimal sensing distance of 5 mm.

function_summary: Differential-drive chassis kit with two gearmotors, two wheels, one ball caster and battery contacts.
classification_reason: Locomotion assembly belongs to legs; its load-carrying chassis offers a secondary torso use for lenient visual combinations.
assembly_notes: Assembly, six AA batteries and motor-control electronics required. Optional second front caster and robot arm are not included.
evidence_note: Vendor lists mechanical kit contents and separately required batteries/electronics; only one caster is included.

function_summary: Pair of 80 mm silicone-tired wheels with interchangeable shaft-gripping collets.
classification_reason: Rolling locomotion components; motors and a robot base are not supplied.
assembly_notes: Two wheel assemblies per catalog unit with inserts and fasteners; assemble collets for the chosen shaft.
evidence_note: Vendor lists a pair of wheels and inserts for 3/4 mm round or D-shaped shafts, with hardware.

function_summary: Passive ball-caster kit providing a rolling support point for a small robot.
classification_reason: Unpowered ground-contact support belongs to locomotion; it cannot drive the robot by itself.
assembly_notes: Includes housing, ball, rollers, spacers and mounting hardware; attach to a chassis with separate powered wheels.
evidence_note: Vendor kit description lists ball, housing, spacers and hardware and identifies small-robot use.

function_summary: Buck-regulator board converting a higher supply voltage to regulated 5 V.
classification_reason: Internal power-conditioning electronics; not a battery, limb or structural part.
assembly_notes: Requires input power and wiring; available output current depends on voltage and heat dissipation.
evidence_note: Vendor identifies D24V10F5 as a 5 V step-down regulator, with typical maximum output of 1 A.
